description: Power analysis of the ARHGAP23 holdup negative: panel overlap among the 25 zero-binder domains, documented-ligand positive controls within that set, and the hit rate excluded by 0 of 42
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

df = pd.read_excel(pd.ExcelFile("Gogl2022_SupplementaryData1.xlsx"), "PDZ-PBM interactome")
df = df[["PDZ","PBM","peptide","COMP_neglogKd"]].copy()
df["COMP_neglogKd"] = pd.to_numeric(df["COMP_neglogKd"], errors="coerce").fillna(0.0)

g = df.groupby("PDZ")["COMP_neglogKd"].agg(n="size", hits=lambda s:(s>0).sum())
g["rate"] = g.hits/g.n
zero = g[g.hits==0].sort_values("n")
print("domains:", len(g), " zero-binder domains:", len(zero))
print(zero.to_string())

# 1. Do the zero-binder domains share one panel?  Compare peptide sets.
sets = {d:set(df.loc[df.PDZ==d,"PBM"]) for d in zero.index}
a23 = sets["ARHGAP23"]
print("\nARHGAP23 panel size:", len(a23))
ov = pd.DataFrame([{"PDZ":d,"n":len(s),"shared_with_ARHGAP23":len(s&a23),
                    "jaccard":round(len(s&a23)/len(s|a23),3)} for d,s in sets.items()]
                 ).sort_values("jaccard",ascending=False)
print(ov.to_string(index=False))

# how common is each ARHGAP23 peptide across ALL 266 domains -> is this a standard core panel?
freq = df.groupby("PBM")["PDZ"].nunique()
print("\nARHGAP23's 42 peptides, number of domains each was tested against:")
print(freq.loc[sorted(a23)].describe().round(1).to_string())
print("median across all 448 PBMs:", freq.median())

# 2. Power: what per-peptide hit rate does 0/42 exclude (one-sided exact)?
n = int(g.loc["ARHGAP23","n"])
rates = np.arange(0.005,0.30,0.001)
p0 = (1-rates)**n
excl = rates[p0<0.05].min()
print(f"\n0 hits in {n} peptides excludes any per-peptide hit rate >= {excl:.3f} at p<0.05")
for r,lab in [(g.loc["ARHGAP21","rate"],"ARHGAP21 observed"),
              (g[g.n>60]["rate"].median(),"median, panels >60"),
              (g[(g.n>=30)&(g.n<=60)]["rate"].median(),"median, panels 30-60")]:
    print(f"  if true rate = {r:.3f} ({lab}): P(0 of {n}) = {(1-r)**n:.2e}")

# 3. Matched-peptide paralogue test on the shared peptides
m = df[df.PDZ.isin(["ARHGAP21","ARHGAP23"])].pivot_table(index="PBM",columns="PDZ",values="COMP_neglogKd")
m = m.dropna()
print(f"\nshared peptides: {len(m)}  ARHGAP21 binds {int((m.ARHGAP21>0).sum())}  ARHGAP23 binds {int((m.ARHGAP23>0).sum())}")
print("Wilcoxon signed-rank p =", f"{stats.wilcoxon(m.ARHGAP21,m.ARHGAP23,alternative='greater').pvalue:.2e}")
print("binomial P(0 of %d | ARHGAP21 rate on same peptides) = %.2e" % (len(m), (1-(m.ARHGAP21>0).mean())**len(m)))

out = g.reset_index().rename(columns={"PDZ":"pdz_domain"})
out["zero_binder"] = out.hits==0
out.to_csv("profaff_power_hit_rates.csv", index=False)
ov.to_csv("profaff_zero_binder_panel_overlap.csv", index=False)
m.to_csv("profaff_ARHGAP21_vs_23_shared_peptides.csv")

fig,ax = plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(13,4.8))
ax[0].scatter(g.n, g.rate, s=16, c="0.65", edgecolor="none")
ax[0].scatter(zero.n, [0]*len(zero), s=34, c="crimson", label=f"zero binders (n={len(zero)})")
for d,c in [("ARHGAP23","crimson"),("ARHGAP21","navy")]:
    ax[0].annotate(d,(g.loc[d,"n"],g.loc[d,"rate"]),xytext=(6,8),textcoords="offset points",color=c,fontsize=9)
    ax[0].scatter([g.loc[d,"n"]],[g.loc[d,"rate"]],s=70,facecolor="none",edgecolor=c,linewidth=1.8)
ax[0].axvline(60,ls="--",c="0.4",lw=1)
ax[0].set_xlabel("peptides tested"); ax[0].set_ylabel("fraction bound")
ax[0].set_title("Every zero-binder domain sits in the small-panel group")
ax[0].legend(fontsize=8,frameon=False)

ax[1].plot(rates, p0, c="navy")
ax[1].axhline(0.05, ls="--", c="crimson", lw=1)
ax[1].axvline(excl, ls=":", c="crimson", lw=1)
ax[1].annotate(f"rates >= {excl:.2f} excluded", (excl,0.5), xytext=(10,0),
               textcoords="offset points", color="crimson", fontsize=9)
ax[1].set_xlabel("true per-peptide hit rate"); ax[1].set_ylabel(f"P(0 hits in {n} peptides)")
ax[1].set_title("What the ARHGAP23 negative can and cannot exclude")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
